notes: Head only. 'put' glosses no element of ἀποσυνάγωγος and is the empty support verb rule 91 sends to its complement; rule 66's compound clause puts the head on the core of the compound (συναγωγ- → 'synagogue') rather than on the prefixed element (ἀπο- → 'out of'), and rule 17 forbids choosing a word merely because it is the phrase's formal verbal head.
